text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rewinding time to the waiting room after 
the Kikuka Sho. I had kept it a secret 
from her, but I had prepared a certain 
present.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...? Who could it be? Coming~

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations, Laurel!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Huh, Mom!? Why are you here!?

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Trainer arranged it all for me... and I'm 
even connected on the phone with Papa 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: D-Dad!?

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations, Laurel. You have 
conquered three grand summits."

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, I was watching the broadcast. 
You were truly shining out there on the 
track."

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Father
text_block_list.text:
"There must have been difficult times as 
well. Mother used to lament about it 
often."

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Every time your Trainer contacts me about 
your legs, I feel like running off and 
whisking you away from the academy..."

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...! Papa!

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Hahaha, sorry, Mom. But I wanted to pass 
on your love to our treasure, too."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Dad, Mom. I might still cause you 
trouble, but—

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Father
text_block_list.text:
""Yes. Keep on running, Laurel. For as 
long as your heart desires.""

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Father
text_block_list.text:
"‘Your running is capable of bringing 
light to someone's heart. Just like it did 
for me today.’"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ………… Thank you, Father.

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Father
text_block_list.text:
"I eagerly await the day you come to 
France to become a hero."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: A hero... that sounds a bit exaggerated.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I'm going—to the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe. Just like my dad is the best in 
the world, I'll become the best daughter 
in the world too.

text_block_list.name: Laurel's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Well then... this is where we part. Thank 
you very much for today.
choice_data_list: The pleasure was all mine, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...You should have just told me.
choice_data_list:
I wanted it to be a surprise for achieving 
the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: That... made me happy, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you as well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I never imagined the day would come when 
I would receive the title of Triple Crown 
Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The future turns out to be so much more 
wonderful than anything we could have ever 
imagined, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "...Or could it be because I met you?"
